I don't have your travel dates or her time zone in front of me, so I'd rather check than guess. Once I have her location and your dates, I can tell you what time it is there right now and what the rainy-season outlook looks like for your visit.
Action: Check your calendar and trip notes for your travel dates, then tell you her local time and whether to worry about the rain, and draft a reply to her.

Great plan for March break. I'll price 3 nights in Drumheller within the week of Mon 16 Mar (Mon to Thu unless you prefer other nights), and look up Royal Tyrrell Museum admission for Leo's age. I'll also check how you'd get there, since it's a drive from Calgary.
Action: Search family-friendly hotels in Drumheller for 3 nights that week, check Tyrrell's child ticket price, and send you options before booking anything.

Here's a draft: 'Hi, thanks for organizing the street party. I can take the 2 to 4 pm volunteer slot at the lemonade table. I won't be able to help with setup, but I'm glad to be part of the day. Thanks, Riya'.
Action: Hold it for your approval; I won't send anything until you've seen it.

Here's a doctor's visit vocab table for your role-play with Carlos on Tuesday, and I'll use this table format for every Spanish vocab list from now on.
| Spanish | English | Example sentence |
|---|---|---|
| la cita | appointment | Tengo una cita con el médico el martes. |
| el síntoma | symptom | Mi síntoma principal es dolor de cabeza. |
| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre desde ayer. |
| el dolor | pain | Siento dolor en el pecho. |
| la tos | cough | Tengo tos y dolor de garganta. |
| la receta | prescription | El médico me dio una receta. |
| la alergia | allergy | Tengo alergia a la penicilina. |
| ¿Dónde le duele? | Where does it hurt? | ¿Dónde le duele exactamente? |
Action: Save the table in the format for Anki, and offer to run the role-play with you before Tuesday.

Got it: no replacement for the 2019 Mazda CX-5 in 2026, the money goes to the kitchen renovation, and an EV is back on the table in 2028. I'll get you off the dealer's lists.
Action: Unsubscribe from the dealer emails and send an opt-out request for any other contact, note the decision in your notes, and offer a reminder to revisit the EV in 2028.

I'll book 30 minutes with Diego and Aisha on the 13th in the afternoon, since you asked for half an hour, with an agenda so no one declines it. Agenda: 1) walk through the new onboarding flows, 2) open questions and decisions, 3) next steps and owners.
Action: Find a 30-minute afternoon slot on the 13th when all three of you are free, book it with that agenda, and tell you the time.

Let me check the actual task list rather than guess. From this thread, the Big Apple hours check is finished and reported.
Action: List every background task and scheduled item currently running, and send only the ones still going.

Have a great dinner! Pool is open tomorrow 7:00 to 20:45, with lanes closed until 9:00, and Leo's packing checklist is shared with Sam.

New message: 'Hi, I'm back but still catching up, so replies may take a little longer than usual. Thanks for your patience, Riya'.

Cardboard fort is a great rainy-day pick. You'll want strong tape (packing or duct), safety scissors for Leo and a box cutter for you, markers, blankets or sheets for the roof, clothespins or clips to hold them, and a flashlight or string lights for inside. Cushions and a few snacks make it feel like a real hideout.

Action: Nothing needed.

Ha, that's a solid snore. Also, Leo's Riverdale Farm trip consent is still pending, due Wed 12 Nov, and Nate has confirmed the cabinets for Mon 10 Nov, 8 to 10 am.

Screen timing matters more than total screen time. In a 2025 study of 1,200 kids aged 6 to 9, a screen in the hour before bed delayed sleep by about 19 minutes, worst with handheld devices. The causes are light delaying melatonin, games keeping kids wired, and screens crowding out wind-down routines. What worked was a fixed screens-off time an hour before bed (weekends too), devices charged outside bedrooms, and reading the last half hour, with sleep back to normal in two weeks.
Action: Nothing needed.

I don't have a confirmation in front of me, so I'll check instead of guessing. I'll search your email and texts for the dentist's replies and look for the November appointments on your calendar.
Action: Find the dentist's confirmation for your appointment and Leo's, and tell you what I find; if there's none, offer to contact the dentist's office.

TFSA: you contribute after-tax dollars, and growth and withdrawals are tax-free with room you get back when you withdraw. RRSP: contributions are tax-deductible and grow tax-deferred, but withdrawals are taxed as income, so it favours people who expect a lower tax rate in retirement.
Action: Nothing needed.

Action: Check the menu, build a surprise family-style order, confirm the total with fees and tip stays under $100, place it for 6:00, and tell you only the total and delivery time.
